observed.implementation: EventBus.register() compares bound methods by __self__ and __func__ in addition to direct callback identity

contract.duplicate_prevention: Registering the same bound method more than once for the same plugin and event does not create duplicate listeners
contract.bound_method_identity: Bound methods are identified by their bound instance (__self__) and underlying function (__func__)
contract.different_instances: The same method on different instances remains independently registrable
contract.different_methods: Different methods on the same instance remain independently registrable
contract.delivery: A duplicated bound-method registration results in exactly one callback invocation
contract.permission_enforcement: The plugin must have the events permission before registration
contract.regression_safety: DTA-119 through DTA-126 EventBus contracts remain passing
